_comment: The tier ladder. Each Warden grants one licence tier and teaches one real thing before making you use it. 'lands' are documentation directories, most-wanted first; a corpus with none of them still gets the Warden a seat (see world._warden_seats). 'body' is a species key from api/bestiary.py. Keep every line under ~180 characters and write -- rather than an em dash.

wardens.name: Tolm
wardens.title: Warden of the Ember
wardens.lesson: Shining costs. Whatever hits hardest runs out first.
lines: You have a marked beast and no idea what it costs it. Sit down.
Every shot it fires, it spends. A bright label spends more. Go and watch one burn out if you do not believe me.
So: last longer than my boar. Attack every turn and you will lose to a slower animal.
wardens.after: Good. You spent it deliberately. Take the Ember.

wardens.name: Ysolde
wardens.title: Warden of the Prism
wardens.lesson: Colour is not decoration. What you emit must land where they absorb.
lines: Name the colour of the thing you are about to hit. You cannot? Then you have been winning by accident.
A shot counts only if the target can drink it. Your green into her green is a wasted afternoon.
My mantis is Azure. Bring me something she wants to absorb.
wardens.after: You picked your band before you swung. That is the Prism.

wardens.name: Kestrel
wardens.title: Warden of the Shutter
wardens.lesson: You cannot catch what you cannot see. The filter decides the world.
lines: Everyone arrives thinking the glass is a bonus. It is not. It is the eye.
Fit the wrong band and half the wild goes invisible. Still there, still hunting you, simply not drawn.
My owl is Umbral. Most of what you carry cannot see her at all. Fix that before you swing.
wardens.after: You changed your glass instead of your team. Take the Shutter.

wardens.name: Ovid
wardens.title: Warden of the Triplet
wardens.lesson: There is a dark state under this one, and things live in it.
lines: A label that pushes too hard does not stop. It crosses -- into a state where it is still there and no longer shining.
I have been down. It is the same world with the light taken out, and the things in it were ours once.
Beat me and I will show you the way in. Refuse, and I will think better of you than most.
wardens.after: Then come and look. The crossing is the cave under the cliffs.

wardens.name: Nera
wardens.title: Warden of the Wellspring
wardens.lesson: Nobody invented this light. It was taken from animals that had it.
lines: Before any of us fixed a dye into anything, there was a jellyfish in cold water that was already green.
Every label you carry descends from an animal that never needed a labeller. Vesper forgets this. Do not.
Face what the sea has had all along, and the last seal is yours.
wardens.after: Now you know where it comes from. Go and tell the Lanternwright.
